accuracy_tie_rule: Predictions exactly equal to 0.5 receive 0.5 accuracy credit; NLL, Brier score, and p(correct) use the unmodified probability.
state_oracle: Closed-form posterior from latent switch count; privileged-information ceiling.
evidence_oracle: HMM likelihood integrated over a uniform hazard prior using Gauss-Legendre quadrature; receives the same noisy evidence prefixes as the model.
